page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Page number top left, running head top centre, section mark "Q. VII." top right. No notes in the margins and nothing below the text.

main_text.p: indiscretis laboribus mentis ut nimis orando vel meditando laedat corporis sanitatem, peccabit quidem spiritus, sed non ideo poterit caro in spiritum imperium sumere; sed gemendo & fatiscendo faciet, ut spiritus remittat aliquid de nimio fervore suo. Sic etiam si forte Princeps spiritualis abutatur potestate sua injuste excommunicando temporalem Principem, vel ejus subditos sine justa causa ab obedientia ejus absolvendo, & eo modo perturbet statum Reip. Temporalis: peccabit princeps spiritualis; sed non poterit tamen Princeps Temporalis judicium sibi sumere de spiritualibus rebus, aut spiritualem Principem judicare, & multo minus de sede sua deponere cont. Bar. clajum c. 17. p. 922. (ubi observetur, quis spiritualis Princeps Bellarmi-no sit; nimirum non tantum Papa, sed etiam quivis Sacerdos. page.notes: The section mark after "Q." in the running head is a special symbol, read here as Q. The line-end "Bar." and "clajum" are split across lines; the name is probably Barclajum, with the printed period kept. Italic and roman type are both used; the citations are set roman. No catchword, signature or marginal notes are printed.
